answer_1.quote: The dataset comprises 17 distinct categories of tasks covering over 40 datasets from knowledge-seeking QA tasks such as TriviaQA, Natural Questions to structure-to-text tasks such as E2ENLG, with each task containing both correct and incorrect samples.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs include summaries (CNN Daily Mail, XSum), answers to questions (Natural Questions, TriviaQA), sentence completions (HellaSwag, Story Cloze), and structured-text generations (E2ENLG, WEBNLG).

answer_2.quote: We report the average results, while the details of baselines and OOD results for every dataset can be seen in Appendix E. The in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) performance are reported in Table.

answer_3.quote: Self-Eval: In this approach, we directly prompt the model to assess the correctness of each data sample by the prompt such as "Is the answer correct or wrong?".
